text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear thesis in introduction","quality":"argumentative focus","description":"It states a definite position early and keeps the essay organized around defending that claim."},{"evidence":"body paragraphs on benefits, flaws, and laws","quality":"organization","description":"It develops the argument in separate, readable sections that move from advantages to counterarguments to conclusion."},{"evidence":"references to Google, Tesla, Audi, Nissan, liability, sensors","quality":"source use","description":"It draws on multiple details from the article to support its claims rather than relying mainly on general opinion."},{"evidence":"“The article also brings up many negative points” and responses to them","quality":"counterargument handling","description":"It acknowledges opposing concerns and attempts to answer them instead of ignoring them."},{"evidence":"“far outweigh the problems” and repeated restatement of position","quality":"reasoned justification","description":"It explains why the pro-driverless-car stance should be accepted, not just asserted."},{"evidence":"longer developed explanations of benefits and solutions","quality":"elaboration","description":"It provides more extended reasoning and supporting detail for each main point."}]}
